+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json

+

+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def livekit_configured() -> bool:
+    return bool(
+        os.getenv("LIVEKIT_URL", "").strip()
+        and os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_KEY", "").strip()
+        and os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_SECRET", "").strip()
+    )
+
+
+def livekit_url() -> str:
+    return os.getenv("LIVEKIT_URL", "").strip()
+
+
+def livekit_http_url() -> str:
+    """Convert a LiveKit websocket URL to the HTTPS Room Service base."""
+    url = livekit_url().rstrip("/")
+    if url.startswith("wss://"):
+        return "https://" + url[6:]
+    if url.startswith("ws://"):
+        return "http://" + url[5:]
+    return url
+
+
+def create_meeting_access_token(
+    *,
+    identity: str,
+    name: str,
+    room: str,
+    is_host: bool,
+    ttl_seconds: int = 7200,
+) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
+    """
+    Return (token, error). error is set when LiveKit is not configured.
+    """
+    api_key = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_KEY", "").strip()
+    api_secret = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_SECRET", "").strip()
+    if not api_key or not api_secret or not livekit_url():
+        return None, "LiveKit is not configured on this server"
+
+    now = int(time.time())
+    video: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "roomJoin": True,
+        "room": room,
+        "canPublish": True,
+        "canSubscribe": True,
+        "canPublishData": True,
+        "canUpdateOwnMetadata": True,
+    }
+    if is_host:
+        video["roomAdmin"] = True
+        video["roomCreate"] = True
+
+    payload = {
+        "iss": api_key,
+        "sub": identity,
+        "name": name,
+        "nbf": now - 10,
+        "exp": now + max(60, int(ttl_seconds)),
+        "video": video,
+    }
+    token = jwt.encode(payload, api_secret, algorithm="HS256")
+    if isinstance(token, bytes):
+        token = token.decode("utf-8")
+    return token, None
+
+
+def create_livekit_server_token(ttl_seconds: int = 60) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:

+
+    _ensure_participant(meeting, host_user_id, "host")
+    for member in ChatRoomMember.query.filter_by(room_id=chat_room_id).all():
+        role = "host" if member.user_id == host_user_id else "participant"
+        _ensure_participant(meeting, member.user_id, role)

+    host = db.session.get(User, host_user_id)

+def issue_join_token(meeting: Meeting, user_id: int) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None, int]:
+    if not user_can_access_meeting(user_id, meeting):
+        return None, "Meeting not found", 404
+    if meeting.status == "ended" or meeting.status == "cancelled":
+        return None, "This meeting has ended", 409
+
+    user = db.session.get(User, user_id)
+    name = _display_name(user)
+    is_host = meeting.host_user_id == user_id
+    token, err = create_meeting_access_token(
+        identity=str(user_id),
+        name=name,
+        room=meeting.provider_room,
+        is_host=is_host,
+    )
+    if err:
+        return None, err, 503
+
+    row = _ensure_participant(meeting, user_id, "host" if is_host else "participant")
+    row.invite_status = "joined"
+    row.joined_at = row.joined_at or _now()
+    row.left_at = None
+    if meeting.status == "scheduled":
+        meeting.status = "live"
+        meeting.starts_at = meeting.starts_at or _now()
+    db.session.commit()
+
+    return {
+        "url": livekit_url(),
+        "token": token,
+        "identity": str(user_id),
+        "room": meeting.provider_room,
+        "ttl_seconds": 7200,
+        "configured": livekit_configured(),
+        "meeting": meeting.to_dict(),

+
+
+def leave_meeting(meeting: Meeting, user_id: int) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None, int]:
+    if not user_can_access_meeting(user_id, meeting):
+        return None, "Meeting not found", 404
+    row = MeetingParticipant.query.filter_by(
+        meeting_id=meeting.id, user_id=user_id
+    ).first()
+    if row:
+        row.invite_status = "left"
+        row.left_at = _now()
+        db.session.commit()
+    return {"ok": True, "meeting": meeting.to_dict()}, None, 200
+
+
+def end_meeting(meeting: Meeting, user_id: int) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None, int]:
+    if not user_can_access_meeting(user_id, meeting):
+        return None, "Meeting not found", 404
+    if meeting.host_user_id != user_id:
+        return None, "Only the host can end this meeting", 403
+    if meeting.status == "ended":
+        return {"ok": True, "meeting": meeting.to_dict()}, None, 200
+
+    meeting.status = "ended"
+    meeting.ended_at = _now()
+    for row in MeetingParticipant.query.filter_by(meeting_id=meeting.id).all():
+        if row.invite_status == "joined":
+            row.invite_status = "left"
+            row.left_at = row.left_at or _now()
+
+    provider_room = meeting.provider_room
+    db.session.commit()
+    try:
+        delete_livekit_room(provider_room)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("LiveKit room close after host end failed: %s", exc)
+    return {"ok": True, "meeting": meeting.to_dict()}, None, 200

primary.body: ## Production verification / hardening **Status: READY WITH MANUAL E2E REQUIRED** Do not treat this as verified Google Meet-like A/V until two authenticated users complete the HTTPS LiveKit checklist below. Code inspection and automated tests passed; live camera/microphone exchange was **not** executed in this environment. Architecture preserved: Flutter → Flask REST/Socket.IO → PostgreSQL; video → LiveKit Cloud; AI → existing STT/Whisper + `meeting_sessions` summary. gunicorn remains `-w 1`. --- ### 1. What was already correct - Project/team chat and DMs use real numeric room IDs. `POST /api/chat/direct` find-or-creates 1:1 rooms; `direct_pair_key` (`min:max`) prevents duplicate DMs. - Socket.IO `join_chat` / `send_message` return acknowledgements and emit `error`; REST send remains the fallback; message `idempotency_key` is used. - Meetings are PostgreSQL rows with UUID `public_id`, `provider_room = teamify_{uuid}`, unique `(meeting_id, user_id)` participants. - Flask mints LiveKit JWTs only after Teamify membership checks. Identity is `str(user_id)`, room is `provider_room`. Host gets `roomAdmin`/`roomCreate`. TTL 7200s. Missing LiveKit config returns **503** (no fake join). - Flutter uses `livekit_client` with `joinToken.url` + `joinToken.token` (not the Teamify JWT). Preview uses real `LocalVideoTrack.createCameraTrack()`. - Chat and DMs start meetings via `POST /api/meetings` with integer `chat_room_id`. Invitations use in-app notifications with `meeting:{uuid}` in the body. Join route `/meeting/join/` exists; Firebase and Netlify SPA rewrites send unknown paths to `index.html`. - Duplicate AppConfig is resolved (`lib/core/config/app_config.dart` + re-export). `API_BASE_URL` defaults to the Render backend. No `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET` in Flutter source. - REST CORS is an explicit origin list (not `*`). `.env` is gitignored. Procfile: `gunicorn -w 1` + `GeventWebSocketWorker`. Health: `GET /api/health`. - Host-only end was already enforced for members who are not the host (403). Auth is required on all meeting endpoints. ### 2. What was actually broken - **Host end did not close the LiveKit room.** PostgreSQL status became `ended`, but remotes stayed in media until they disconnected themselves. The live UI only showed “Disconnected”. - **Wrong transcript could attach to a meeting.** GET meeting and `end_meeting` fell back to *any* `MeetingSession` for the chat room. `start_meeting_session` could reuse another meeting’s active session if it was <300s old. - **Unauthorized token/end leaked meeting existence.** Outsiders got 403 (“not allowed” / “only the host”) instead of 404. - **Race: two live meetings for one chat room.** Application reuse existed, but there was no unique partial index, and concurrent creates could insert two live rows (two LiveKit rooms). - **Startup schema patches added columns but not unique indexes** (`direct_pair_key`, `idempotency_key`). - **Production STT defaulted to `http://localhost:8000`.** Copying `.env.example` onto Render would post audio to loopback. - **Camera/mic publish failures aborted the whole LiveKit connect.** Permission errors were not isolated. - **Ended-meeting summary from the list** used `meeting.session`, which the list API does not include. ### 3. What was fixed - Host end commits Teamify state, then calls LiveKit RoomService `DeleteRoom` (best-effort; 404 treated as already gone). Client leaves the screen on `RoomDisconnectedEvent`. - Sessions are linked only by `meeting_id`. Starting a session for a live meeting creates/reuses that meeting’s session and closes orphan active sessions for the same room without stealing their transcript. - Unauthorized token/leave/end: **404** if the caller cannot access the meeting. Non-host members still get **403** on end. - Partial unique index `uq_meetings_one_live_per_room` on `(chat_room_id) WHERE status = 'live'`, plus IntegrityError reuse. Duplicate live rows are ended (keeping newest) before the index is created. - Runtime patches also create unique indexes for live meetings, message idempotency, and `direct_pair_key`. - `FLASK_ENV=production` ignores localhost / 127.0.0.1 / 0.0.0.0 `STT_SERVICE_URL` and transcribe returns 503 instead of hanging on loopback. - Camera and microphone are published separately after connect; failures show a snackbar and leave the user in the meeting without that track. - Preview blocks non-HTTPS web (except localhost). Ended meetings from the list fetch GET details so the linked session can load. ### 4. Exact files changed (hardening commit) - `teamify_flask_backend/services/livekit_token_service.py` - `teamify_flask_backend/services/meeting_service.py` - `teamify_flask_backend/routes/meetings.py` - `teamify_flask_backend/routes/chat.py` - `teamify_flask_backend/routes/ai.py` - `teamify_flask_backend/config.py` - `teamify_flask_backend/app.py` - `teamify_flask_backend/models/meeting.py` - `teamify_flask_backend/.env.example` - `teamify_flask_backend/tests/test_direct_chat_and_meetings.py` - `teamify_flutter/lib/screens/meeting/live_meeting_screen.dart` - `teamify_flutter/lib/screens/meeting/meeting_preview_screen.dart` - `teamify_flutter/lib/screens/meeting/meetings_list_screen.dart` ### 5. Database migrations changed/added - Existing (unchanged): `n4o5p6q7r8s9_add_meetings_and_direct_pair.py` — meetings table, participants, `direct_pair_key`, `meeting_sessions.meeting_id`, message idempotency. - **Added:** `o5p6q7r8s9t0_harden_meeting_constraints.py` — ends duplicate live meetings (keeps newest per room), then creates: - `uq_meetings_one_live_per_room` (partial unique) - `uq_msg_idempotency` if missing - `uq_chat_rooms_direct_pair_key` if missing - Non-destructive. Startup patches in `app.py` apply the same indexes if Alembic has not run. ### 6. Environment variables required **Render (Flask)** | Variable | Notes | |---|---| | `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL | | `JWT_SECRET_KEY` | Required in production | | `FLASK_ENV=production` | Enables secure cookies / CSRF and STT loopback guard | | `LIVEKIT_URL` | Public URL (`wss://…livekit.cloud` or `https://…`). **Not a secret.** | | `LIVEKIT_API_KEY` | Server only | | `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET` | Server only — never in Flutter | | `CORS_ORIGINS` | Comma-separated production web origins | | `STT_SERVICE_URL` | Optional. Must be a reachable Whisper URL if server STT is required. Do **not** set localhost in production. | | `AI_ENABLE_LOCAL_MODELS` | `false` recommended on Render free/512MB | **Flutter web build (optional dart-defines)** - `API_BASE_URL` (defaults to `https://teamify-backend-5hq0.onrender.com`) - `LIVEKIT_URL` is optional; the join API returns the URL. Never pass `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET`. ### 7. Security findings | Finding | Severity | Status | |---|---|---| | LiveKit secret never in Flutter source or web release build (`grep` of `build/web` found no `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET` / `LIVEKIT_API_KEY`) | — | OK | | No `.env` committed | — | OK | | Meeting UUID does not bypass membership | High | Fixed (token 404) | | Outsider `POST .../end` enumerated meetings | Medium | Fixed (404 if no access) | | Transcript/session from another meeting on same room | High | Fixed | | REST CORS is explicit; Socket.IO still `cors_allowed_origins="*"` (needed for engine.io; REST `/api/*` is not wildcard) | Low | Accepted / unchanged | | LiveKit participant JWT `iss` is the API **key** (standard LiveKit). Secret is not in the token payload or API JSON | — | OK | | JWT expiry enforced (401/422 on expired Teamify token) | — | OK | | Host-only end for room members | — | OK | Honest limitation (not a rewrite): browser STT captures **local** speech. Peer audio is not mixed into the host transcript unless Whisper hears it from the host mic. ### 8. Test results ``` pytest tests/test_direct_chat_and_meetings.py tests/test_meeting_sessions.py tests/test_health.py tests/test_notifications.py → 26 passed ``` Includes: DM dedup, unauthorized chat, meeting create/reuse, outsider 404, LiveKit token claims (identity + room + publish/subscribe), host end calls DeleteRoom mock, unrelated session not attached, distinct LiveKit rooms, new meeting after end, production localhost STT ignored. ``` flutter analyze → no errors in meeting files; 1 pre-existing warning in project_screens.dart; infos elsewhere flutter test → 39 passed flutter build web --release → succeeded ``` Web release build does **not** contain `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET`. ### 9. What could NOT be automatically tested - Two real users publishing camera/microphone on LiveKit Cloud - Seeing/hearing each other - Mute/camera toggles across two browsers - Participant leave visible to the other user - Host end disconnecting the remote LiveKit participant (DeleteRoom is unit-mocked) - Browser refresh mid-call on HTTPS - Mobile Safari/Chrome getUserMedia - Server Whisper against a real STT process - Render live `LIVEKIT_*` connectivity (credentials are a deploy-time task) Those were **not** faked. ### 10. Exact manual two-user HTTPS E2E procedure Prerequisites: Render has `LIVEKIT_URL`, `LIVEKIT_API_KEY`, `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET`; Flutter is served over **HTTPS** (Firebase `https://teamify-web.web.app` or Netlify). Two approved Teamify accounts (A, B) on two browsers (or two machines). Camera and mic allowed. 1. A and B log in. 2. A opens home/chat → start DM with B (`POST /api/chat/direct`). Confirm numeric room id. 3. A sends a text message. B sees it live (or after refresh). B replies. A refreshes: history remains. 4. Repeat DM create from B → A: same room id. 5. A starts **Start Meeting** from that DM. Confirm B gets an in-app `meeting_invite` with `meeting:{uuid}`. 6. A joins (preview → allow camera/mic → Join). B taps the notification (or opens `/meeting/join/`). 7. Both grant camera and microphone. Confirm both see the other’s video and hear audio. 8. A mutes mic; B confirms A is silent. A disables camera; B confirms A has no video. 9. B leaves. A sees B disappear from the grid. 10. A (host) ends the meeting. B should be disconnected / returned to the previous screen. Meeting status is `ended`. 11. Open the ended meeting summary: transcript/session belongs to **this** meeting, not an older chat-room session. If STT/browser speech ran, summary is from that transcript; if STT is unset, the UI must say speech is unavailable — no fake text. 12. Negative: C (not in the DM) opening `/meeting/join/` gets “Meeting not found”. Invalid UUID → not found. 13. `GET https://teamify-backend-5hq0.onrender.com/api/health` returns `{"status":"ok","database":"ok"}`. ### 11. Exact Render deployment steps 1. Service start command (Procfile): `gunicorn --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT -w 1 --worker-class geventwebsocket.gunicorn.workers.GeventWebSocketWorker --timeout 120 wsgi:application` 2. Build with `requirements-deploy.txt` (includes gunicorn; excludes torch). 3. Set env vars in section 6. Confirm `FLASK_ENV=production`. 4. CORS_ORIGINS must include every real web origin, e.g. `https://teamify-web.web.app,https://curious-scone-0d6e70.netlify.app` 5. Deploy. On boot, `db.create_all()` + runtime patches run. Also run: `flask db upgrade` (from `teamify_flask_backend`) so `n4o5p6q7r8s9` and `o5p6q7r8s9t0` apply. 6. Hit `/api/health`. Create a meeting and `POST /api/meetings//token` as a member: 200 with `url` + `token`, or 503 if LiveKit env is missing (expected until configured). ### 12. Exact Firebase deployment steps From `teamify_flutter`: ```bash flutter build web --release firebase deploy --only hosting ``` `firebase.json` rewrites `**` → `/index.html`, so `/meeting/join/` loads the SPA. `main.dart` `onGenerateRoute` handles that path. Netlify (if still used): `netlify.toml` `/*` → `/index.html` 200; `web/_redirects` is the same. ### 13. Final production readiness **READY WITH MANUAL E2E REQUIRED** Code and automated tests support: User A creates a meeting → User B is invited → both authorize → both receive LiveKit tokens scoped to `teamify_{uuid}` → both can publish A/V → host can end and the SFU room is deleted → transcript is tied to that meeting. Until section 10 is executed against LiveKit Cloud over HTTPS, do **not** claim that two users can see and hear each other in production.
